findings.claim: The diff changes the SceneCard in ScenesSectionPresenter.tsx (a 7.6rem min-height on the whole card, justify-start, and the removal of the per-span min-h-[2.4rem] and min-h-[2.45rem]), and none of the four Presenter touch points (column count, removal of max-w-96, loading skeleton, window band) covers it.
findings.impact: The scene card's height and layout change at every width, including the 384px inspector. Before, a one-line label was followed by a blank reserved line. Now the text follows it directly and the spare space sits at the card's foot. My arithmetic puts the maximum content at about 7.59rem (1rem time line + 2 × 0.25rem gaps + 2 × 1.203rem label + 2 × 1.219rem text + 1.25rem padding), so 7.6rem still holds the section height steady (SPEC-ADDON-089 I5). This is a visible change outside the declared plan, made under the human decision D-1 in decisions.md:16.
findings.evidence: addons/intelligence/frontend/ScenesSection/ScenesSectionPresenter.tsx:526 (min-h-[7.6rem] ... justify-start), :535 and :538 (the line-clamp-2 spans no longer have min-h). The touch-point list in docs/specs/scene-timeline-width.md names only the grid column count, max-w-96, the skeleton and the band for the Presenter. The change is recorded in docs/process/reviews/feature-scene-timeline-width/design-check.md:18-20 (D-1) and decisions.md:16, but the spec's touch points were not updated.

specification_compliance: Every other path the diff reaches is listed or implicit: the scenesModel.ts window function and sceneColumns; the Container's window, requests and columns; the Presenter grid columns, max-w-96 removal, skeleton and band; the new __tests__/ScenesSectionWidth.test.tsx; scenes-section.cases.ts; both spec files; fixtures/app.tsx (the scenes-688 arrangement); the gitlink; plus the implicit docs/specs files and INDEX.md.
useRulerWidth.ts is unchanged in the diff, as the touch points say ('read only'). Only its call site in the Container moved.
No new spec file was added, so spec-viewport.spec.ts is rightly untouched.
potential_unspecified_behavior: The SceneCard's total min-height of 7.6rem replaces per-line reservations, so a scene with a one-line label and no text now leaves its spare space at the card's foot rather than between the label and the text. This applies at every width, not only in wide hosts.
regression_risks: The 7.6rem card min-height is a hand-computed sum. A future change to the card's font size, line-height, gap or padding could exceed it, and then the section height would change between scenes (SPEC-ADDON-089 I5). Today's e2e height check would catch that only for the fixture's specific label and text lengths.
test_coverage: The e2e cases check that a one-line label takes one line (labelLines 1) and that a long label clamps to two lines, at 384, 390, 688 and 900px. Section height equality across the frame-0 card (short label, no text) and the frame-5 card (long label, long text) covers the card height reservation.

jsdom tests in ScenesSectionWidth.test.tsx cover column counts, root font fallbacks, the window start at 5 columns, requests, the band, the width-change redraw and the skeleton. None checks the SceneCard classes.
